subject: prd/prototype
statement: When a prototype run ends, Pyxis shall record each thing the run taught as a finding of kind technical challenge or product conflict, stating what was tried and what was observed.
rationale: "try to understand what are the challenges technical challenges where the product conflicts that we need to think through" (brainstorm:prototype#D-7)
fit_criterion: The run's findings record holds at least one finding, or the explicit statement that the run found none; every finding carries its kind, what was tried, and what was observed
